import pytest
from datetime import datetime
from date_math import add_days, days_until_year_end, is_leap_year, days_in_month


# Basic tests (these should pass)
def test_add_days_basic():
    """Test basic date addition."""
    date = datetime(2024, 1, 1)
    result = add_days(date, 5)
    assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 6)


def test_add_days_negative():
    """Test adding negative days (going backward)."""
    date = datetime(2024, 1, 10)
    result = add_days(date, -5)
    assert result ==
